title: Auth — OOB Grant — payload
description: The member's decision on one out-of-band request, as an attestation: "let this starter key act as me at this origin until notAfter, having seen this context", or a decline. Issued by the DID that proved membership and signed by its VTA for `assertionMethod`, only after user verification. Never sent on its own, only carried inside auth/oob/respond. Closed: additionalProperties false and no `ext`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

decision.description: The member's decision. A decline still names the context it declines, and needs no user verification.

sessionKey.description: The starter key `K_b`, from step 2. On approve, the only key the grant lets act as the issuer.

approverKey.description: The lock key `K_a`. MUST equal the issuer of the respond that carries this document.

origin.description: The portal origin from step 2, at which the session key may act.

contextDigest.description: SHA-256 multihash, multibase-encoded, over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the signed step 2 response document (the auth/oob/prove response), proof included. Binds the decision to exactly what the member was shown.

notAfter.description: The latest instant the session key may act as the issuer. The service ends the session at the earlier of this and its own session limit.
